fields.FIR_Description: The reported incident took place on 2025-09-10 (afternoon, 16:10): The complainant was allegedly surrounded and attacked by several persons near Poongodi Layout Residential Colony in Tiruppur after a dispute over a minor road collision. The online submission was made by Naveen Mani (9000000021). Suspicion was reportedly directed towards Vignesh Balan, using the number 9000000105. The complaint refers to another person whose identity could not be established.
